title: Data Protection Officer, Deputy Data Protection Officer
salary_range: Rs. 26.71 lakh per annum (DPO), Rs. 18.38 lakh per annum (Deputy DPO)
age_limit: Not more than 50 years as on November 01, 2026 (DPO); Not more than 40 years as on November 01, 2026 (Deputy DPO)
summary: EXIM Bank is inviting applications for the contractual positions of Data Protection Officer (DPO) and Deputy Data Protection Officer (Deputy DPO) in Mumbai. There is one vacancy for each post. Candidates must be graduates with relevant experience and mandatory certifications in data privacy.
eligibility_bullets: For Data Protection Officer (DPO): Graduate in any discipline from a recognized University/Institution with minimum 60% aggregate marks.
For Data Protection Officer (DPO): Mandatory certification (valid as on cut-off date) from CIPP/E, CIPP/A, CIPM, FIP (IAPP), CDPSE (ISACA), DCPP, DCPLA, DCDPO (DSCI), or CDPO (PECB).
For Data Protection Officer (DPO): Minimum 15 years' post-qualification experience in an executive/managerial capacity in the corporate sector, preferably BFSI.
For Data Protection Officer (DPO): Of the above, a minimum of 5 years in a senior managerial/leadership role and 5 years in data privacy/data protection or closely allied disciplines.
For Data Protection Officer (DPO): Age should not be more than 50 years as on November 01, 2026.
For Deputy Data Protection Officer (Deputy DPO): Graduate in any discipline from a recognized University/Institution with minimum 60% aggregate marks.
For Deputy Data Protection Officer (Deputy DPO): Mandatory certification (valid as on cut-off date) from CIPP/E, CIPP/A, CIPM, FIP (IAPP), CDPSE (ISACA), DCPP, DCPLA, DCDPO (DSCI), or CDPO (PECB).
For Deputy Data Protection Officer (Deputy DPO): Minimum 5 years' post-qualification experience in an executive/managerial capacity in the corporate sector, preferably BFSI.
For Deputy Data Protection Officer (Deputy DPO): Of the above, a minimum of 2 years in data privacy/data protection or closely allied disciplines.
For Deputy Data Protection Officer (Deputy DPO): Age should not be more than 40 years as on November 01, 2026.
how_to_apply_steps: Eligible candidates must send their resume as per the attached format.
For DPO, the subject line should be: "DPO Application: Mr./ Ms. (Full Name)".
For Deputy DPO, the subject line should be: "Deputy DPO Application: Mr./ Ms. (Full Name)".
Shortlisted candidates will be informed for a personal interview at the Mumbai office.
